note: Starter trio of ship hardpoint weapons. Each fills one gold weapon pad. Same Ace art family as the player fleet. Concepts live in art/weapons/{id}.png. No GLBs yet.
styleLock:
3D game-ready concept of a SINGLE standalone spaceship weapon module, isolated on a clean light-gray studio background. No ship, no hangar, no scenery.

CAMERA: high 3/4 isometric from above-front-right, same product-shot camera as the crimson Ace interceptor catalog. Entire weapon fully in frame, centered, no cropping. Slight downward angle like a top-down arcade game. Orthographic isometric product shot.

STYLE: Same locked ART FAMILY as Ace (StarCraft Terran + Ratchet & Clank / Fortnite / Astroneer toyetic, bright colors, slightly low-poly, thick panel lines). SAME materials language: crimson-red plates, cream/white plates, charcoal mechanics. NOT photoreal, NOT grimdark.

MOUNT: Circular gold mounting collar at the BOTTOM — the piece that bolts onto a ship's gold hardpoint pad. Underside has a dark hexagonal plug. Gold exists ONLY as that one mounting collar.

MOD SLOTS: Exactly 4 empty hexagonal crystal wells with cream bezels and dark empty glass. NOT gold. Count them: 4. Nothing inserted.

Lighting: bright studio key, soft fill, punchy rim light. Low-poly stylized 3D product render.

DO NOT INCLUDE: a spaceship, a second weapon, hangar, stars, nebula, planet, text, logo, watermark, photorealism, grimdark, people, hands, extra gold circles, crystals already plugged in, cropped weapon.

rules.stash: At the end of each level, stash found items into persistent inventory or keep them on this run. Death keeps what you entered with; run-only finds are lost.
